channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: World’s largest drone fleet deployed to deter Russia
item.description: NATO says it deployed the world's largest unmanned fleet in the Baltic, operating 50 drones before the US added another 20, as a cheaper and more sustainable alternative to using frigates for constant patrols. The post World’s largest drone fleet deployed to deter Russia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rutte in Munich: Europe stepping up to lead NATO
item.description: Speaking at the Munich Security Conference, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said allies are undergoing a "real shift in mindset", with Europe taking greater responsibility for defence. #MSC2026 The post Rutte in Munich: Europe stepping up to lead NATO first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Baroness warns of ‘unpleasant smell’ over Palantir contract
item.description: Baroness Goldie criticised the decision to award a contract to Palantir without open tender, alleging "a very unpleasant smell" and asking what was discussed at a meeting involving the Prime Minister, Palantir and Peter Mandelson. The post Baroness warns of ‘unpleasant smell’ over Palantir contract first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US urges Europe to take lead in NATO conventional defence
item.description: A senior US defence official has called on European NATO members to assume primary responsibility for the conventional defence of Europe. The post US urges Europe to take lead in NATO conventional defence first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: EU official warns Russian shadow fleet threatens Europe
item.description: Speaking at the Munich Security Conference, the EU's top diplomatic official Belén Martinez Carbonell warned that Russia's shadow fleet is now one of the most direct maritime security threats facing Europe. #MSC2026 The post EU official warns Russian shadow fleet threatens Europe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Marines fire mortars in Arctic Norway training
item.description: Royal Marines have carried out live mortar firing drills in northern Norway as part of preparations for a major NATO exercise and an expanded UK role in Arctic security. The post Royal Marines fire mortars in Arctic Norway training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Indian Air Force to help train British jet pilots
item.description: Indian Air Force instructors are set to begin training Royal Air Force fast jet pilots at RAF Valley under a new agreement that may also help ease long-running pressure on Britain's military flying training pipeline. The post Indian Air Force to help train British jet pilots first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain set to deploy aircraft carrier strike group
item.description: Keir Starmer has confirmed that the UK will deploy its Carrier Strike Group to the North Atlantic and High North regions later this year, with HMS Prince of Wales set to lead the deployment. #MSC2026 The post Britain set to deploy aircraft carrier strike group first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to send carrier north in show of force against Russia
item.description: The UK will deploy a Carrier Strike Group to the North Atlantic and High North in 2026 under Operation Firecrest, aimed at deterring Russia and protecting critical undersea infrastructure. The post UK to send carrier north in show of force against Russia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Scottish Secretary to pursue shipbuilding deals in Indo-Pacific
item.description: The UK Government has announced that Scottish Secretary Douglas Alexander will travel to Australia, New Zealand and Singapore on a week-long trade and defence mission. The post Scottish Secretary to pursue shipbuilding deals in Indo-Pacific first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
